name: Action Type 15 Code
definition: Type of action to be performed by the point of interaction (POI).

DISP.name: Display Message
DISP.definition: Message to display, print or log.

NOVR.name: Forbid Override
NOVR.definition: Payment application cannot propose to the merchant an override of the payment transaction.

RQID.name: Identification Required
RQID.definition: Additional identification required (passport, ID card, etc.).

PINR.name: PIN Retry
PINR.definition: PIN (Personal Identification Number) is wrong, retry a PIN verification.

RQDT.name: Request Data
RQDT.definition: Request additional data through a displayed text and request confirmation by an attendant.

DCCQ.name: Accept Currency Conversion
DCCQ.definition: Ask the cardholder to accept the currency conversion.

FLFW.name: Fall Forward
FLFW.definition: Fall-forward from contactless to chip card transaction required.

PINQ.name: PIN Request
PINQ.definition: Request Cardholder Authentification through PIN insertion.

CDCV.name: Consumer Device Cardholder Verification Method
CDCV.definition: Request Cardholder Authentification according to the ConsumerDeviceCardholderVerificationMethod.

STAR.name: Stop All Recurring
STAR.definition: Recurring transactions is no more allowed for this card and for all merchants.

STOR.name: Stop One Recurring
STOR.definition: Cardholder has revocated this recurring transaction for this merchant.

ACUP.name: Account Update
ACUP.definition: Indicates that the account was updated and should be taken into account for future authorisation.

TALT.name: Try Again Later
TALT.definition: Indicates that the authorization should be resubmitted at a later time.

DNTA.name: Do Not Try Again
DNTA.definition: Indicates that this account shouldn't be used anymore.

NCOF.name: Card On File Not Supported
NCOF.definition: Reference used to process the transaction has been created for this transaction and shouldn't be used for additional transactions.
